in_sanskrit.name: द्युमन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is brilliant like the sun, supreme among the gods Skanda (Kartikeya)

in_marathi.name: Dyumana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dyumana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Dyum’ meaning ‘bright, radiant, or sky’. In Hindu mythology, Dyumana is a celestial being and the charioteer of the Sun God, Surya.

in_bengali.name: Dyumana
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Bright, Radiant
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dyumana একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Dyum’ meaning ‘bright, radiant, or sky’. In Hindu mythology, Dyumana is a celestial being and the charioteer of the Sun God, Surya.
